# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONT_EARLY_ENTRY

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP_CONTINUATION setup fires on the first qualifying morning bar ≤10:30 ET. Restricting entry to ≤10:00 ET may capture stronger trend continuation before midday chop, increasing edge on J's bearish winner days while avoiding low-quality late-morning signals that contribute to loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: same as VWAP_CONTINUATION (first 3 RTH closes same side of session VWAP, first bar ≤10:00 ET that continues in-trend via breakout or shallow pullback). Exit logic unchanged: chart-stop-primary invalidation, TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3 qty), runner moves to breakeven after TP1, chandelier profit-lock trails 0.15 off high-water mark, time stop 15:50 ET. Contract selection: ITM-2 for Bold, ATM/OTM-2 for Safe per account tier. Position sizing follows risk-rules.md.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure 1).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use 16-month window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with in-sample/out-of-sample split; risk of overfit due to multiple hypothesis testing; we will mitigate with walk-forward and out-of-sample validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will compute walk-forward OOS Sharpe after Stage-1 backtest).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top-3 J days using real OPRA fills).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if filter removes winning entries on 4/29 or 5/01, edge_capture drops below 771; max drawdown scenario: prolonged sideways market causing whipsaw entries; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing premature stops.
6. **Concentration:** Will compute top-5 days % of P&L after backtest; unknown until Stage-1 completes.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators (e.g., `test_vwap_cont_early_entry.py`) must pass; walk-forward OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.70; real-fills validation on top-3 J days showing <±20% difference vs BS simulator; anchor no-regression (edge_capture ≥ 771); all OP-20 disclosures satisfied.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- requires Stage-1 backtest to quantify edge_capture and OOS Sharpe.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This is a filter_change to the live VWAP_CONTINUATION setup (j_vwap_cont_enabled=true, side='both'). It proposes a parameter tweak (`j_vwap_cont_entry_cutoff=10:00`) rather than a new structural signal, so it does not conflict with existing candidates that are structural or watcher-only. It complements the existing VWAP_CONTINUATION by potentially improving its edge_capture and Sharpe; if successful, it could be merged as a param update to the live setup. No known conflicts with current leaderboard entries.
